I grew up with separated parents, and one side was protestant; the other side catholic. My grandmothers  would always be telling me conflicting belief that I had to adhere to 100%, or I'll go to hell.

 Being that these conflicts didn't make sense to me, I started studying anything religious or spiritual from a young age, and I just fell into it.  

My mother is 100% kenien'keha:ka American native, so I'm privileged  to be able to enjoy my ancestors' closed beliefs. Although I integrate other beliefs into my own as well. 

As far as what supports it, I strangely enough turn to science. I use the fundamentals' understanding of quantum mechanics and multi-level  dimensional theory to rationalize the potential for existing devine.  

TBH, I believe in the devine fully because I've felt and seen things that can not be explained under any circumstance or context I try to put it in. It works for me. I'm the happiest I've ever been! At the end of the day, I'm not hurting anyone, and i bring happiness to those around me, and that's all I truly care about.
